fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have measurable disease, as defined by RECIST v1.1 using computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Previously irradiated lesions cannot be counted as target lesions unless there has been demonstrated progression in the lesions since radiotherapy and no other lesions are available for selection as target lesions
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with new or progressive brain metastases (active brain metastases) are eligible if the treating physician determines that immediate central nervous system (CNS) specific treatment is not required and is unlikely to be required during the first cycle of therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Involves active brain metastases under specific investigator discretion and treatment requirements, not a simple typed category.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have a life expectancy of ≥ 12 weeks
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must be willing to undergo a mandatory pre-treatment biopsy (28 days before treatment starts on cycle 1 day 1 [C1D1]) for patients enrolled into the expansion phase (phase II). The pre-treatment biopsy is optional for patients enrolled into the dose escalation phase (phase I)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a biopsy is a procedure requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients who have had prior treatment with an antibody drug conjugate with a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor payload (i.e., sacituzumab govitecan, datopotomab deruxtecan, or trastuzumab deruxtecan) or with a topoisomerase inhibitor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusions involving multiple named ADCs and drug classes are best left to fuzzy criteria.
